column3: “Seven, seven” preserves the repeated distributive numeral rendered “seven pairs.”
“Seven, seven” preserves the repeated numeral; “seed” preserves the collective image rendered “offspring.”
The entry lists Noah, his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives in that order.
Repeats “on this day” after the full date.
Repeats “according to its kind” for the several groups and ends “every bird, every wing.”
“All flesh in which is the breath of life” preserves the collective body image rendered “every creature with the breath of life.”
“As God had commanded him” does not repeat Noah’s name; “shut behind him” preserves the spatial expression rendered “shut him in.”
The waters prevailed “very, very”; the mountains then “were covered,” without a separate initial clause that the earth was completely inundated.
“Fifteen cubits upward the waters prevailed, and the mountains were covered” preserves the two clauses without explicitly naming “mountaintops.”
“Breath of the spirit of life” preserves both breath terms compressed into “breath of life.”
The first wiping-out verb is active, “He wiped out,” before the passive “they were wiped out.”
